input-trace.description: Live throttle, brake, and clutch inputs.

close-battle.description: Who is fighting you right now, on a vertical distance axis.

wheel-to-wheel.description: You and your nearest rival side by side: gap and speed.

relative.description: Gaps to cars ahead and behind you.

track-map.description: Dynamic 2D map of the current circuit.

relative-map.description: Progress bar of car track positions.

led-flags.description: LED matrix display of track flags.

flat-flags.description: Banner-style list of active track flags.

delta.description: Live delta HUD — one glance, am I faster or slower?

g-meter.description: Lateral and longitudinal G-force friction circle.

sector-matrix.description: Sector-by-sector timing with progress bar, live delta per sector, LAST and BEST.

lap-log.description: Last 8 laps with time and delta vs personal best. Best lap highlighted.

engine-panel.description: Liquid temperatures, pressures, and every in-car adjustment the car exposes — ABS, traction control, brake bias, engine map, engine braking and the differential.

rpm-lights.description: Standalone shift-light LED bar driven by engine RPM, with pit-limiter animations.

race-dash.description: Cockpit cluster: gear ring, speed readout with lap/position/RPM, and pit-lane mode.

stream-chat.description: Twitch and YouTube live chat in one feed.

pit-service.description: Pit stop order: fuel, tires, repairs and tow time.

pit-line.description: Pit lane speed against the limit, and the roll to your stall.

coach.description: Brake/gas call and a speed trace against your stored best lap, colored by time gained or lost.

invisible-dash.description: Windscreen projection: engine column and gear on the left, position and lap on the right, empty in the middle.

battery.description: Hybrid battery charge, what the MGU-K is doing with it, and the deploy mode on cars that expose a selector.

drs.description: Drag reduction system state: armed past the detection point, ready inside the zone, open.

common.nameColumnWidthDesc: Width of the driver-name column, in pixels at the widget’s design scale. The table is exactly as wide as its visible columns, so narrowing the name narrows the whole table instead of shrinking the text.
common.useLivePositionsDesc: Rank by position on track, recomputed every tick. Off: the sim's official number, which only updates when a car crosses start/finish. Applies to every session type.
common.classPositionInMulticlassDesc: In a multiclass session count the position within your own class instead of the whole field. Single-class sessions are unaffected — there the two are the same number.
common.licBadgeStyleDesc: Badge is the two-tone chip, No Background is the bare rating in the license color, Dark keeps the class letter on its colored plate and writes the rating in that color on a near-black ground.
common.qualifyingVisibilityDesc: Auto: hidden during lone qualifying (single car on track)
common.classShapesDesc: Give each car class its own marker shape (circle, square, diamond) on top of its color; the shapes repeat if there are more classes.
common.paceCarUseClassColorDesc: Color the safety-car marker by its class instead of a custom color.
common.paceCarShowInPitsDesc: Keep showing the safety car while it's parked in its pit stall.
common.rowPaddingDesc: Vertical padding of each driver row.
common.showPitIndicatorDesc: Show icon when driver is in pits.
common.playerRowColorDesc: Highlight color for your own row.
common.playerAccentColorDesc: Color of your position and car number.

referenceDesc.personalBest: Your best clean lap this session.
referenceDesc.personalOptimal: Your theoretical best — fastest sector from each of your laps combined.
referenceDesc.sessionBest: Fastest lap set by any driver in the current session.
referenceDesc.sessionOptimal: Theoretical best — fastest sector from any driver in the session combined.
referenceDesc.sessionLast: Last fully completed lap by any driver in the session.

fuel.showStatAvg10: AVG ALL — average of every lap
fuel.showNextStopForecastDesc: Estimated lap and time until the pit window opens.
fuel.fuelAvgWindow: Consumption Averaging Window, Laps (0 = All Laps)
fuel.fuelAvgWindowDesc: Nearly the whole widget is derived from this average: the summary AVG cell, LAPS LEFT, the fuel left at the finish, the refuel amount and the pit window edges. A short window tracks the current pace but jumps around; a long one reads steady but is slow to follow a change in pace or weather. The AVG ALL column always spans every lap, so the two read side by side.
fuel.countYellowFlagLapsDesc: Use laps run under a local yellow flag in the fuel average. On a road course a yellow rarely slows the lap enough to change consumption. Full-course cautions and red flags are always left out.

enginePanel.horizontalDesc: Align cells horizontally in a single row instead of a vertical grid.
enginePanel.horizontalColumnsDesc: Number of columns for the horizontal layout (3, 4, or Max).
enginePanel.verticalColumnsDesc: Number of columns for the vertical layout (1 to 4).
enginePanel.showTc2Desc: Show the second traction control channel, on cars that have one.
enginePanel.showBrakeBiasFineDesc: Show the fine brake bias trim, in points on top of the coarse value.
enginePanel.showPeakBrakeBiasDesc: Show the peak brake bias setting.
enginePanel.showDiffEntryDesc: Show the corner entry differential setting.
enginePanel.showDiffMiddleDesc: Show the mid corner differential setting.
enginePanel.showDiffExitDesc: Show the third differential setting — corner exit on some cars, high speed on others.
enginePanel.highlightChangesDesc: Flash a cell when the driver moves that adjustment — green for the brake cells, blue for the differential.
enginePanel.showAntiRollFrontDesc: Show the front anti-roll bar setting, on cars that adjust it from the wheel.
enginePanel.showAntiRollRearDesc: Show the rear anti-roll bar setting, on cars that adjust it from the wheel.
enginePanel.showBrakeMiscDesc: The car’s extra brake control — brake bias migration on the hybrid prototypes.

flagDisplay.alwaysShowDesc: Show widget even when no flag is active.
flagDisplay.holdDurationDesc: How long to keep the flag visible after it clears.
flagDisplay.forceSingleLedDesc: Show a single large indicator instead of the LED matrix.
flagDisplay.splitDesc: Split matrix into left & right parts to place around mirror.
flagDisplay.animateDesc: Enable dynamic scrolling and waving patterns for flags.

inputTrace.showThrottleDesc: Show throttle trace on the graph.
inputTrace.showBrakeDesc: Show brake trace on the graph.
inputTrace.absColorDesc: Color of the brake trace/bar when ABS is active.
inputTrace.showClutchDesc: Show clutch trace on the graph.
inputTrace.showSteeringDesc: Show steering wheel block and graph trace.
inputTrace.steeringWheelStyleDesc: Which steering wheel silhouette the block draws.
inputTrace.steeringCenterDisplayDesc: What to show in the center of the steering wheel.
inputTrace.steeringCenterPlateDesc: Round plate behind the readout, so it stays legible over a gap in the wheel.
inputTrace.steeringMarkerColorDesc: Color of the straight center-grip stripe painted on the rim.
inputTrace.steeringZoomDesc: Graph shows ±{{angle}}° ({{zoom}}x) of the {{lock}}° steering lock — change the lock in Settings › Steering Wheel
inputTrace.showTraceDesc: Show the scrolling input history graph.
inputTrace.showInputValuesDesc: Show throttle, brake and clutch percentages inside the bars.

linearMap.flagZoneStyleDesc: Outline keeps the same colour and opacity but paints only the edges, leaving the track surface under the zone visible.
linearMap.showIncidentZonesDesc: Mark a warning stretch of the lap around cars stopped on track or sitting off it. iRacing gives no position for a yellow or a debris flag, so the incident itself is what gets located.

radar.hideDelayDesc: Seconds the scope stays up after the last car has left it.
radar.scopeActivationDesc: The scope shows itself whenever a car is inside the range it draws — set that range under Scope below. There is no separate activation radius.
radar.barActivationDesc: The bar is the spotter's own call: a side lights up while the spotter reports a car there, and goes out the moment it is past.

scaleModeDesc.fixed-scope: The circle always covers the same distance. Resizing the widget zooms the whole picture, like every other widget.
scaleModeDesc.fixed-cars: Cars keep the same size on screen. A bigger widget fits more track into the circle.
scaleModeDesc.manual: You set how far the circle reaches. The further it reaches, the smaller the cars.

radar.scopeReadout: Around your car: {{range}}. Rings: {{rings}}. Ticks on the axis every {{ladder}}.
radar.showAxesDesc: Crosshair plus distance ticks along the track — the one direction the sim measures.
radar.showAxisTicksDesc: Distance marks along the vertical axis.
radar.showBeamDesc: A sector as wide as the opponent, following it while it stays in the circle.
radar.showEdgeMarkersDesc: An arc on the rim for a car that is outside the circle but still close enough to wake the radar.
radar.carOpacityDesc: The alpha every car on the scope is drawn at, yours included.
radar.beamOpacityDesc: Opacity of the beam at its densest point; distance fades it from there.
radar.monochromeCarsDesc: Off: each car takes the color of the danger it is in.
radar.backgroundTextureDesc: Drawn over the background color, or on its own when the background is transparent.

closeBattle.triggerDesc: What counts as "close": a gap in seconds, or a real distance in meters.
closeBattle.thresholdDesc: An opponent inside this shows up; the plate leaves at 1.3 x this value. Each trigger keeps its own number.
closeBattle.hideDelayDesc: How long a row stays after the opponent left the threshold.
closeBattle.maxRowsDesc: More than three is a pack, not a battle.
closeBattle.otherClassDesc: Traffic from another class: full, dimmed, or not shown at all.
closeBattle.hideInPitsDesc: The cars around you in the pits are queueing, not racing you.
closeBattle.glowRangeDesc: Distance at which the glow starts to build, above or below your line depending on the side. 0 turns it off.
closeBattle.showAxisDesc: The dashed distance line and its ticks. Off leaves only the plates, the glow and your own line.
closeBattle.showPlayerLineDesc: The horizontal mark at the centre — the one that never moves.
closeBattle.compactModeDesc: Axis only: positions and glow, no plates, names or numbers.
closeBattle.showLapGapDesc: Whole laps between you and the car, as "1L" beside the gap.
closeBattle.showBrandDesc: The make abbreviated to three letters, as in Standings.
closeBattle.nameModeDesc: How much of the name the plate carries. The surname always stays — it is what the eye catches at speed.
closeBattle.mergeOverlappingDesc: Cars that land on the same point of the axis share one plate, which names them rather than counting them. Two plates shoved apart would claim a gap that is not there.
closeBattle.mergeDistanceDesc: How close two cars must be on track to share a plate — a car length or two. Decided in meters, not in pixels: cars merge because they are side by side, not because the axis is zoomed out.
closeBattle.plateOpacityDesc: Fades the plate itself -- the numbers on it stay at full strength. The only other thing that fades a row is dimming another class, and that one pushes the whole row back, text included.
closeBattle.scaleByDistanceDesc: Distant plates get smaller, never past a third.

wheelToWheel.layoutDesc: Columns puts your rival beside you; rows stacks every driver in track order — ahead, you, behind.
wheelToWheel.gapThresholdDesc: The nearest car of your class on your lap inside this gap is your rival; it leaves the plate at 1.3 x this value.
wheelToWheel.hideDelayDesc: How long the plate stays after the rival left the threshold.
wheelToWheel.includeLappedDesc: In a race, a car a lap ahead or behind counts as a rival too. Outside a race lap counts are ignored anyway.

raceDash.colorizeByRpmZoneDesc: Tint the gear digit and RPM number with the zone color at high revs.
raceDash.showSteeringMarkerDesc: Show a dot orbiting the outer rim of the gear ring one-to-one with the steering wheel.
raceDash.steeringTrailColorDesc: Color of the trail the steering marker leaves behind it on the rim.
raceDash.colorizePositionDesc: Tint the P-number by which band of the field you are running in.
raceDash.showPitAssistDesc: Transform into the pit panel when entering the pit lane.
raceDash.pitSpeedLimitOverrideDesc: Leave 0 to auto-detect from session data.
raceDash.nearLimitDeltaDesc: Color speed amber when this many {{unit}} below the pit speed limit.

relative.qualifyingVisibilityDesc: Auto: other drivers are hidden during lone qualifying (single car on track). Your own row always stays.
relative.showLicBadgeDesc: Driver safety rating badge (A, B, C, D, R).
relative.showLicenseLetterDesc: Show the class letter in the SR badge ("A 4.99"); off keeps the rating alone ("4.99").
relative.abbreviateIRatingDesc: Round the column to a thousand ("9.9k"); off spells it out ("9873") and widens the table.
relative.abbreviateNamesDesc: Use short names to save space.
relative.showCountryFlagDesc: Show the driver's profile country flag before the name.
relative.showDriverFlagsDesc: Show active warning flags next to driver name.
relative.useLivePositionsDesc: Rank by position on track, recomputed every tick. Off: the sim's official number, which only updates when a car crosses start/finish. Row order always follows the gap on track.
relative.showCarNumberDesc: Class-colored car number badge, right after the position.

sectorMatrix.showSectorsDesc: Display per-sector timing grid. Disable for a compact view with just the progress bar and lap times.
sectorMatrix.showPredictedDesc: Estimated finish time displayed in the header.

standings.scrollResetSecondsDesc: Return to the automatic view after this long without scrolling. In grouped view the class on top scrolls first; once it runs out the table moves up a class, bringing the ones that did not fit into view. The wheel scrolls whichever class it is pointed at.
standings.showPosChangeDesc: Arrow showing positions gained or lost since session start.
standings.showLivePosChangeDesc: Flash an up or down arrow over the position number for a few seconds after a place changes.
standings.groupedRowsPerClassDesc: Driver rows each class gets in grouped view. Auto splits the widget height evenly between the classes on track. Rows Around You carves the bottom of each block out for the cars near you.
standings.driversAheadDesc: Rows shown in front of you when you no longer fit in the top of the table.
standings.driversBehindDesc: Rows shown behind you when you no longer fit in the top of the table. 0 ahead and 0 behind pins your row alone at the bottom.
standings.showBrandDesc: Manufacturer badge next to driver name.
standings.showTireDesc: Visual indicator of current tire type.
standings.showLicBadgeDesc: Driver safety rating badge (A, B, C, D, R).
standings.showLicenseLetterDesc: Show the class letter in the SR badge ("A 4.99"); off keeps the rating alone ("4.99").
standings.abbreviateIRatingDesc: Round the column to a thousand ("9.9k"); off spells it out ("9873") and widens the table.
standings.showIrChangeDesc: Projected iRating gain or loss based on current position.
standings.showLapsCompletedDesc: Number of laps completed by each driver.
standings.abbreviateNamesDesc: Shorten names to save column space.
standings.showCountryFlagDesc: Show the driver's profile country flag before the name.
standings.showDriverFlagsDesc: Display active warning flags (e.g. Mechanical Damage/Meatball) next to driver name.
standings.hideRetiredDriversDesc: Remove rows for cars that left the session for good. Your own row always stays.
standings.showColumnHeadersDesc: Show labels above each data column.
standings.showSessionHeaderDesc: Laps or time remaining bar at the top.
standings.showSessionTimeDesc: Time remaining (or elapsed) in the header, same clock as the Timer widget.
standings.showWeatherDesc: Wind and temperature row in the footer.
standings.showSOFDesc: Average iRating of all registered drivers.
standings.abbreviateSofDesc: Round the SOF to a thousand ("6.1k"); off spells it out ("6148").
standings.showPitStopsDesc: Number of pit stops made by the player car.
standings.showIncidentsBadgeDesc: Incident count accumulated by the player car, and the penalties earned and the next one when the session gives a penalty every few incidents.
standings.showTotalDriversDesc: Total number of drivers in the session.
standings.dimSecondaryColumnsDesc: Paint last lap, laps, gap, brand and iRating in the muted text color.
standings.hideDriversWithoutLapDesc: In practice and qualifying, drop rows for cars that have not set a lap time yet. Your own row always stays.
standings.showGapDesc: Time or laps to the leader of the current view.
standings.showLastLapDesc: Each driver's most recent lap time.
standings.showBestLapDesc: Each driver's fastest lap; the qualifying time stands in until one is set.
standings.useLivePositionsDesc: Rank by position on track, recomputed every tick — drives the position number, row order, move animation and the projected iR change. Off: the sim's official number, which only updates when a car crosses start/finish. Applies to every session type.

timer.showSessionTypeDesc: Display the current session type (Race, Qualify, Practice).
timer.showLapsDesc: Display current lap and total laps.
timer.showSimDateDesc: Display in-simulator date (may differ from real date).

trackMap.qualifyingVisibilityDesc: Auto: other drivers are hidden during lone qualifying (single car on track). Your own marker always stays.
trackMap.playerDotColorDesc: Ping ring and label pill color for your car.
trackMap.showPlayerLabelDesc: Display the label above your car dot.
trackMap.zoomEnabledDesc: Show a magnified section of the track around your car instead of the whole circuit.
trackMap.zoomRotateDesc: Keep the map turning so your car stays in place facing up.
trackMap.zoomCircleBackgroundDesc: Fill the follow circle with a solid ground so the map does not blend into what is behind the overlay.
trackMap.flagZoneStyleDesc: Outline keeps the same colour and opacity but paints only the edges, leaving the track surface under the zone visible.
trackMap.showIncidentZonesDesc: Mark a warning stretch of the lap around cars stopped on track or sitting off it. iRacing gives no position for a yellow or a debris flag, so the incident itself is what gets located.
trackMap.useLivePositionsDesc: Pick the P1 label by position on track, recomputed every tick. Off: the sim's official number, which only updates when a car crosses start/finish — a car towed back to the pits keeps the lead until then.

weather.horizontalDesc: Wide layout: compass and conditions on one row, stats and forecast underneath.
weather.showCompassDesc: Animated compass showing current wind direction.
weather.showCompassRingDesc: Cardinal directions and the compass circle. Turn off to show only the arrow and car.
weather.showAirTempDesc: Ambient air temperature at track level.
weather.showTrackTempDesc: Surface temperature of the racing surface.
weather.showWindDesc: Numerical wind speed and cardinal direction.
weather.showWindBearingDesc: Exact wind bearing in degrees, shown next to the wind label.
weather.showForecastDesc: Upcoming weather changes during the session.
weather.showTrackWetnessDesc: Current track surface wetness level (Dry, Damp, Wet, Flooded).

streamChat.maxMessagesDesc: How many messages stay scrollable. The feed shows as many as the widget can fit.
streamChat.messageLifetimeSecondsDesc: Seconds before a message fades out. 0 keeps everything.
streamChat.compactRowsDesc: Nick and message share one line. Off puts the message under the nick.
streamChat.showPlatformGlyphDesc: Platform icon before the nick, so the source stays readable when the stripe colours blur.
streamChat.showEventsDesc: Subscription and raid rows. Paid messages — Super Chat and cheers — always stay visible.
streamChat.showFollowsDesc: New follower rows. They arrive only over EventSub, so they need a Twitch account connected to the channel being watched.
streamChat.showBannerDesc: Top line with the connection state and room restrictions such as followers only.
streamChat.showPlaceholderDesc: Show the “waiting for messages” line while the chat is quiet.
streamChat.badgeImagesDesc: Draw the real badges instead of text plates. Twitch needs sign-in; YouTube member badges work without it.

pitService.showFuelDesc: Ordered fuel, the calculated recommendation and how far the order differs from it.
pitService.showTiresDesc: Per-corner order, wear, temperatures and pressure.
pitService.showRepairsDesc: Repair countdowns in the box, plus the fast repair, windshield and compound orders.
pitService.showFooterDesc: Order state, auto mode, stop counter and current position.
pitService.alwaysVisibleDesc: Keep the widget on screen instead of showing it only on pit road and while being towed.
pitService.showProjectedPositionDesc: Estimate of where the car rejoins, from the repair and tow countdowns and the gaps of the cars behind. An estimate, not a prediction — it assumes they keep their pace and do not pit.
pitService.strategyMoved: These rules belong to the car, not to a screen: every pit box shows the same order. The fuel steps and the auto-mode rules are set in Settings → Data → Shared values.
pitService.commandRevealSeconds: Show for {{seconds}} s after a command
pitService.commandRevealSecondsDesc: How long the panel shows itself after a tyre, fuel or auto-mode key, so a press on track can be read back. Zero switches it off. The temporary-show key is not affected — it stays up until pressed again.
pitService.revealOnApproachMDesc: The sim reports nothing about heading for the pits, so this is pure distance to the pit entry line — enough to change the order on the way in. Zero switches it off and the box appears on pit road as before.

pitLine.alwaysVisibleDesc: Keep the widget on screen instead of showing it only on pit road and while being towed.
pitLine.showPitSpeedDesc: Current speed read against the pit limit, with the lift-off band and the limiter state.
pitLine.showPitApproachDesc: Distance to your stall drawn over the pit lane, with the stall marked and a braking cue.
pitLine.showPitBrakeCueDesc: Mark where braking has to start to roll to a stop in the stall at the current speed, and flash the rail once you are there.
pitLine.showUnitsDesc: Write km/h and m under the columns. Off, the numbers stand on their own.
pitLine.revealOnApproachMDesc: The bars carry their own approach distance, apart from the pit box: they are read at the entry itself. Zero switches it off and they appear on pit road.

coach.showCallRowDesc: The BRAKE / GAS call row on top. Off leaves only the trace and the readouts.
coach.showUrgencyBarDesc: Bar under the call showing how close the next braking zone is.
coach.showCornerExitCallsDesc: Judge corner exits on the throttle: how many metres later than the reference you opened it, and how much pedal is missing. Stays quiet while the car is being corrected.
coach.showTraceDesc: Draw the speed trace under the call. Off leaves just the call row and the widget shrinks to it.
coach.windowMetersDesc: How far behind and ahead of the car the trace reaches.
coach.referenceColorDesc: Color of the stored reference lap the trace is compared against.
coach.gainColorDesc: This lap where it is up on the reference lap.
coach.lossColorDesc: This lap where it is down on the reference lap.
coach.showSpeedDesc: Current speed against the reference lap speed at this point.
coach.showReferenceLapTimeDesc: Lap time of the stored reference lap the trace is compared against.
coach.showTrackConditionDesc: Whether the dry or the wet reference lap is in use right now.
coach.traceChannelDesc: Speed shows where the time goes; brake shows how the pedal was applied.

invisibleDash.renderModeDesc: Projection glows like a head-up display. Contour outlines the glyphs instead — readable on bright tracks, where a glow washes out.
invisibleDash.bloomIntensityDesc: Strength of the glow around the digits — {{percent}}%.
invisibleDash.projectionTintDesc: Color of the halo around the digits. The digits themselves keep their own color.
invisibleDash.textColorDesc: Color of the numbers below the high rev zone.
invisibleDash.depthDesc: Pushes the readout into the scene — tilt, shrink and fade. The text is rendered supersampled, so it stays sharp at any distance.
invisibleDash.showSpeedDesc: Largest number in the left cluster, in the app's unit system.
invisibleDash.showRpmDesc: Engine speed above the speed readout.
invisibleDash.rpmFormatDesc: Absolute revolutions, or the share of the redline reached.
invisibleDash.showShiftBarDesc: Hairline bar over the engine column, filling with the revs in the zone color.
invisibleDash.showGearDesc: Sits next to the engine column, the largest glyph in the strip.
invisibleDash.showPositionDesc: Place in the field, in the right cluster.
invisibleDash.showLapDesc: Current lap out of the session total, under the position.
invisibleDash.colorizeRpmByZoneDesc: Tint the RPM number with the zone color at high revs.
invisibleDash.colorizeGearByZoneDesc: Tint the gear digit with the zone color at high revs.
invisibleDash.useLivePositionsDesc: Rank by order on track instead of the sim's official number, which only refreshes at start/finish.
invisibleDash.classPositionInMulticlassDesc: Count the position within your own class instead of the whole field.
invisibleDash.backdropColorDesc: Wash behind the digits, alpha included. Where it lands is set below.
invisibleDash.backdropScopeDesc: Clusters leaves the middle of the strip clear. Whole strip paints one plate behind everything, tilted along with the digits.
invisibleDash.curvatureDesc: How hard the readout wraps around the glass: the two sides turn away from you and ride up toward the pillars.

battery.compactModeDesc: Show only the charge bar and its percentage, hiding the deploy mode, power and lap deploy rows.
battery.showDeployModeDesc: Show the MGU-K deploy mode strip. Hidden anyway on cars whose selector never moves.
battery.showPowerDesc: Show what the MGU-K is doing and how hard, in kilowatts.
battery.showLapDeployDesc: Show the energy sent from the battery to the MGU-K on this lap, in megajoules.

drs.hideWhenCarHasNoDrsDesc: Take the widget off the screen on a car that has no DRS at all. Off, the plate stays and reads N/A.
drs.hideWhenUnavailableDesc: Draw nothing while DRS is unavailable, instead of a quiet plate.
